pairs.question: Cur non illi quoque eadem furta temptarent?
pairs.answer: Verum intellecturos facilius esse Herculi clavam quam Homero versum subripere.
pairs.derivation: Reported defense of Vergil against the charge of borrowing from Homer. Dropped the leading framing 'sed hoc ipsum crimen sic defendere adsuetum ait:' which narrates the speaking. The interrogative 'cur non illi quoque eadem furta temptarent?' is directly answered by the following sentence; cut ends at the full stop before 'Et tamen destinasse secedere...', which begins a new unrelated topic. Capitalized first word of question.
